paths.description: The heart of the content-addressable storage. This stores all core data objects (blobs, trees, commits).
A single place to store references to stash commits. Similar to objects/ but for stash.
A file keeping a reference to the latest stash. This allows us to keep a stack reference for the stash

This file acts as the staging area. It's a crucial intermediate step between the working directy and the reposity history. It lists files and their corresponding blob hashes that are staged for the next commit
